title: judgepanel: estimating LLM-judge accuracy without gold labels
description: Estimates each judge's confusion matrix, the class prevalence, and a posterior over every item's true label from a panel of imperfect judges labelling the same items, with no gold labels, via the Dawid-Skene model fitted by EM. Includes majority-vote baselines, Cohen's and Fleiss' kappa agreement diagnostics, bootstrap confidence intervals, and panel simulators for planning and failure-mode analysis. Validated on a real five-judge panel over 400 agent trajectories where estimated judge accuracies can be checked against construction-time gold labels, including an honest account of the correlated-judge failure mode.
